407:t_2:18.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I'm giving you this key. Use it when the fleet is in danger.」

407:t_2:20.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I'm counting on you... to look after the fleet...」

407:t_2:21.en:
$$リジット$$
「Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$! $$ガルガンティア$$ needs you!」

407:t_2:22.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... You're... the new Fleet Commander...」

407:t_2:24.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...You've grown... so much... I can... proudly... tell your... late father... that.........」

407:t_2:31.en:
$$レド$$
「So that's Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s machine...」

407:t_2:32.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Welcome, emissary from the heavens, clad in a giant of thunder. In the name of providence, may you have prosperity and peace.」

407:t_2:33.en:
$$レド$$
[$$チェインバー#pilot$$... What is this woman saying?]

407:t_2:34.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I believe it is an idiomatic expression referring to a $$マシンキャリバー$$ and its pilot.]

407:t_2:35.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「My name is $$オンデリア$$. I serve as this fleet's priestess.」

407:t_2:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The word means a woman who serves a god.]

407:t_2:38.en:
$$レド$$
「Where is Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$?」

407:t_2:39.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「...It seems the preparations are nearly complete.」

407:t_2:40.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Forgive me for speaking over video.」

407:t_2:41.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$...! I'm glad you're safe...」

407:t_2:42.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I'm not entirely safe. I caught an endemic disease...」

407:t_2:43.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I can't leave my sterilized cockpit. Are you all right?」

407:t_2:45.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I see... Giving orders from here is surprisingly troublesome.」

407:t_2:47.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Having you here would help. What do you say? Will you serve under me again?」

407:t_2:49.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「What's wrong? Do you still have ties to that local unit?」

407:t_2:50.en:
$$レド$$
「...No, sir. I'll place myself under your command.」

407:t_2:51.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I see... Now we can start our mission.」

407:t_2:53.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Despite this planet's abundant environment, its people are overwhelmed by the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ and $$サイデリアル$$, and live in fear.」

407:t_2:54.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our mission is to teach them to fight and enlighten them about humanity's dignity.」

407:t_2:55.en:
$$レド$$
「...About that, sir. The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... they're human.」

407:t_2:56.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「They were human once, weren't they?」

407:t_2:58.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Apparently, it was an unspoken understanding among the top brass. But we frontline soldiers don't need that information.」

407:t_2:60.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ merely live and reproduce according to their desires. You can't call them human.」

407:t_2:62.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The strong and weak use reason to support each other. Each contributes in their own way to build society. ...That's what being human means, isn't it?」

407:t_2:64.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I brought order to this fleet. As a result, under the current ruling system, its members' happiness has increased significantly.」

407:t_2:65.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request a definition of happiness in this context.」

407:t_2:66.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...Answer that, $$ストライカー#pilot$$.」

407:t_2:67.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「In $$銀河同盟$$ philosophy, happiness is a state of maximum cost-effectiveness when an individual serves the whole.」

407:t_2:68.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Therefore, happiness is proportional to the stability of leadership.」

407:t_2:69.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I agree with the definition and conclusion.」

407:t_2:71.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Listen, $$レド$$... Won't you help me change this planet?」

407:t_2:72.en:
$$レド$$
「You want to change this planet...」

407:t_2:73.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The fleet you belonged to has already joined mine.」

407:t_2:74.en:
$$レド$$
(He means $$ピニオン$$ and the others' ships...)

407:t_2:75.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I'd like to enlist your help right away.」

407:t_2:76.en:
$$レド$$
「Does this concern the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$?」

407:t_2:77.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「No... Our work to enlighten this planet's inhabitants.」

407:t_2:78.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「We'll change people's thinking that way, eventually uniting humanity's will on this planet and transforming them into a strong society.」

407:t_2:79.en:
$$レド$$
「...If those are your orders, sir, I will comply.」

407:t_2:80.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「That's what I wanted to hear. Now that you're here, I'll carry out the enlightenment operation I've long been planning.」

407:t_2:81.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our target is a fleet called $$ガルガンティア$$.」

407:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your hard work, $$オズマ$$.」

407:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You needn't say a word. I know this is about $$ブレラ$$.」

407:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your strong resolve when you fought $$ブレラ$$ produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s... I'll add them to the team's stock.」

407:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I was surprised, though. You and $$ブレラ$$ usually weren't particularly close.」

407:t_10:9.en:
$$オズマ$$
「He's $$ランカ$$'s brother... which makes him my brother, too.」

407:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... Then with $$アルト$$, you are three brothers-in-law.」

407:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh? I thought you'd get angry and say, 'I won't let him anywhere near $$ランカ$$!'」

407:t_10:13.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's for $$ランカ$$ and $$アルト$$ to decide. It's no longer my place to interfere.」

407:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are admirable, $$オズマ$$. Let me buy you a drink today.」

407:t_10:15.en:
$$オズマ$$
(That's how it is, $$ランカ$$. Live for yourself, with no regrets.)

407:t_10:16.en:
$$オズマ$$
(We'll find a way to help $$ブレラ$$. Don't worry. Just wait for us...)

407:t_10:23.en:
$$シェリル$$
「We've taken a double hit...」
